Its three-toed forelegs are splayed out in a 'Whoops!' gesture. One hind leg is kicking up a large, stylized dust cloud, while the other is tangled in mid-air. FACIAL EXPRESSION: Eyes are crossed comically with a 'dazed' look, and its tongue is slightly poking out of its mouth. ART STYLE: 'STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3' with rounded, toy-like forms and soft leathery skin. LIGHTING: 'SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC' to highlight the 3D volume of the tumble.
